acceptance.assertion: The existing chronik_events_ingested_total metric name remains available for compatibility, but its HELP text and documentation unambiguously define it as validated events presented for ingestion rather than proof of durable persistence; signal-strength metrics receive the same attempt-level boundary.

A bounded chronik_events_persisted_total counter records only events that were successfully appended to authoritative storage. For agent.ledger it increments by the storage result's written count, so identical replays and conflicts add zero durable events; for other domains it increments only after a successful write.

A bounded agent.ledger request-outcome counter distinguishes accepted, replayed, mixed, conflict and invalid-identity outcomes without using event_id, payload content, repository names or other unbounded labels.
Storage failures, identity conflicts and missing identities cannot increment durable-write metrics, and error responses expose no raw event or ledger content.
The change does not alter HTTP success bodies, idempotency, ledger bytes, index state, retry semantics or non-agent.ledger ingestion behavior; only metric accounting and HELP text change.

Focused Prometheus regression tests prove first delivery, identical replay, mixed batch, conflicting replay, invalid identity, generic-domain success and storage failure accounting; the complete Chronik validation suite, role contract, CI and exact-head smoke remain green.

goal: Make Chronik metrics distinguish validated delivery attempts, newly durable ledger writes, identical agent.ledger replays and identity conflicts without breaking existing metric names, increasing label cardinality or changing storage semantics.
